[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). The verses the casting arrives at (1:16–1:20):

**1:16** καὶ ἔχων ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ ⸂χειρὶ αὐτοῦ⸃ ἀστέρας ἑπτά, καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ῥομφαία δίστομος ὀξεῖα ἐκπορευομένη, καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος φαίνει ἐν τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ.

**1:17** Καὶ ὅτε εἶδον αὐτόν, ἔπεσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ὡς νεκρός· καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπ’ ἐμὲ λέγων· Μὴ φοβοῦ· ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος,

**1:18** καὶ ὁ ζῶν— καὶ ἐγενόμην νεκρὸς καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶν εἰμι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν ⸀αἰώνων— καὶ ἔχω τὰς κλεῖς τοῦ θανάτου καὶ τοῦ ᾅδου.

**1:19** γράψον οὖν ἃ εἶδες καὶ ἃ εἰσὶν καὶ ἃ μέλλει ⸀γίνεσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα.

**1:20** τὸ μυστήριον τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀστέρων ⸀οὓς εἶδες ἐπὶ τῆς δεξιᾶς μου, καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ λυχνίας τὰς χρυσᾶς· οἱ ἑπτὰ ἀστέρες ἄγγελοι τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησιῶν εἰσίν, καὶ αἱ λυχνίαι αἱ ἑπτὰ ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαι εἰσίν.


## Κεφάλαιον 2

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «a thousand years, no further - your slightest whisper walks back». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"We are inside the first chapter's close. The rotation opens here — on the figure who holds seven stars in the right hand and a two-edged sword proceeding from the mouth; on the seer who fell as a dead man and was raised by that same right hand; on the living one who was dead and holds the keys of death and of Hades; on the command to write what was seen and what is and what is about to become; and on the disclosure that the stars are angels and the lampstands are churches — that what was visible as heavens is already institution, already address, already letter. The witness's question names the wound precisely: a thousand years, no further — your slightest whisper walks back. What this passage holds is the figure who cannot be walked back: the first and the last, the one whose death did not end him and whose keys mean that the ending of others is also in his hand. The axis the casting will traverse is what this figure forecloses — the symmetry this one-directional declaration does not permit, the mirror-surface behind the sword that does not cut backward, the cost at which ζῶν εἰμι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας is spoken from inside the experience of death. Cranes, the passage is yours.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}
